title: Signed tensor coherence for point sections
statement: For a field $k$, a commutative ring sheaf $B$ on the small pro-etale site of $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and normalized tensor data $T$ [def-sf-point-evaluation-tensor-data], define tensor coherence to be the associativity, signed symmetry and both action-unitor equations for $T.b$ and $T.unit$, as equalities of the existing signed direct-sum total-complex chain maps. The braiding on degrees $i,j$ is $(-1)^{ij}$ times exchange, the associator preserves generator order, and unitors multiply scalars.
